title: Experience the Power of Divine Healing and Breakthrough
description: Get ready for a supernatural encounter with the power of God as Pastor Chris Zehner leads an unforgettable service at The River Church of Kansas City. In this explosive sermon, Pastor Chris declares that it's time to receive a fresh anointing of the Holy Ghost and experience a season of divine healing, financial breakthrough, and restoration like never before. Join us as we dive into the intensity of God's presence and discover how to step into a life of greater power and purpose.
